categories.name: Warranty & Coverage
categories.definition: Calls about warranty eligibility, warranty terms, coverage duration, exclusions, transferability, or paid-service-plan eligibility.
categories.rationale: Merges warranty, support plan, and coverage-eligibility requests while keeping coverage distinct from repair execution.

categories.name: Repair & Service Case
categories.definition: Calls about an active or requested repair, depot or onsite service, repair-center routing, case handling, or technical-support escalation.
categories.rationale: Combines repair, repair case, support case, hardware repair, repair center, and support-routing labels.

categories.name: Returns, Replacement & Refunds
categories.definition: Calls about returning a product, requesting a replacement, exchanging a product, or obtaining a product or service refund.
categories.rationale: Groups return, replacement, refund, and trade-in requests because they are all post-sale resolution outcomes.

categories.name: Orders, Billing & Shipping
categories.definition: Calls about purchasing, order status, invoices, payment, shipping materials, delivery, or fulfillment logistics.
categories.rationale: Separates commercial and fulfillment activity from technical support and product-return decisions.

categories.name: Setup & Data Transfer
categories.definition: Calls about initial device setup, in-home setup, migration, file transfer, backup, or data preservation during service.
categories.rationale: Splits setup and data-migration work from general software troubleshooting.

categories.name: Operating System & Applications
categories.definition: Calls about Windows, ChromeOS, Microsoft 365, applications, drivers, updates, activation, recovery software, or operating-system configuration.
categories.rationale: Splits the overly broad software label into an actionable software area while retaining OS recovery and application issues together.

categories.name: Accounts, Access & Security
categories.definition: Calls about user accounts, login credentials, BitLocker, device access, authentication, theft protection, or security concerns.
categories.rationale: Merges account, login, access, BitLocker, and security labels because they concern access to or protection of the device and data.

categories.name: Boot, BIOS & Firmware
categories.definition: Calls about startup, boot devices, boot managers, BIOS settings, firmware, POST behavior, or firmware updates.
categories.rationale: Combines boot, Windows boot, startup, BIOS, and firmware issues that require pre-operating-system support.

categories.name: Display
categories.definition: Calls about the built-in display, external display output, backlight, screen image, flicker, or physical screen damage.
categories.rationale: Merges screen and display while treating display behavior as distinct from the graphics component or dock.

categories.name: Keyboard, Touchpad & Pointing Devices
categories.definition: Calls about keyboards, touchpads, trackpads, TrackPoint devices, mice, styluses, or other user-input pointing hardware.
categories.rationale: Combines keyboard, touchpad, trackpad, mouse, stylus, and TrackPoint labels into one input-device category.

categories.name: Audio, Camera & Biometrics
categories.definition: Calls about speakers, microphones, cameras, fingerprint readers, or related built-in media and biometric devices.
categories.rationale: Combines the lower-volume audio, microphone, camera, and fingerprint categories into a coherent built-in-device group.

categories.name: Network & Wireless Connectivity
categories.definition: Calls about Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Bluetooth, cellular or WWAN connectivity, network adapters, internet access, or network authentication.
categories.rationale: Merges Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Bluetooth, cellular, mobile broadband, and network-card labels while excluding physical port failures.

categories.name: Power & Charging
categories.definition: Calls about powering on, power adapters, power cords, charging behavior, shutdown power behavior, or power delivery.
categories.rationale: Combines power-on, charging, power cord, power supply, shutdown, and power-management labels because they concern device power delivery or state.

categories.name: Thermal & Cooling
categories.definition: Calls about overheating, fans, cooling systems, thermal performance, or temperature-related shutdowns and noise.
categories.rationale: Merges overheating, fan, cooling, and cooling-fan labels into an actionable thermal category.

categories.name: Storage & Memory
categories.definition: Calls about hard drives, SSDs, storage detection, RAM, memory performance, or failed storage and memory components.
categories.rationale: Combines storage, hard drive, hard disk, and memory labels because they are internal data-storage or system-memory resources.

categories.name: Motherboard, Processor & Graphics
categories.definition: Calls about the system board, motherboard components, CPU, GPU, graphics hardware, or board-level internal failures.
categories.rationale: Consolidates motherboard, system board, GPU, and board-level hardware labels that are handled as internal component service.

categories.name: Ports & Expansion
categories.definition: Calls about USB, USB-C, Thunderbolt, Ethernet ports, card readers, SD slots, PCI or other physical expansion interfaces.
categories.rationale: Separates physical connector and expansion failures from the network or accessory connected through them.

categories.name: Docks, Monitors & Accessories
categories.definition: Calls about docking stations, monitor connections, external monitors, cables, printers, mice or keyboards used as external accessories, and compatible accessory purchases.
categories.rationale: Groups docking station, external monitor, printer, cable, and accessory-specific labels around externally connected equipment.

categories.name: Performance & Stability
categories.definition: Calls about general slowness, freezing, crashing, unexpected restarting, instability, or system behavior that does not identify a more specific component.
categories.rationale: Provides an actionable home for broad hardware, computer, performance, freezing, restarting, and stability complaints after specific component categories are excluded.

categories.name: Other / Unclear
categories.definition: Calls whose primary product or service area cannot be assigned reliably to another taxonomy category.
categories.rationale: Retains a controlled exception bucket for misrouted, unsupported, or insufficiently specific requests rather than forcing a misleading technical category.

notes: The original software category is too broad; operating-system, application, update, driver, activation, and setup issues should be analyzed separately at drill-down level.
Screen and display were merged, while external-monitor and dock issues were placed with external equipment so built-in display defects remain measurable.
Power-on, charging, battery, power cord, shutdown, and power-management labels were consolidated under Power & Charging because the sample does not require separate top-level reporting for each.
Repair case, support case, support line, support transfer, and technical-support labels describe service operations rather than a product component and belong in Repair & Service Case.

The sample contains several unsupported or misrouted requests, including human resources and some tablet or server requests; these are retained in Other / Unclear when no Lenovo PC service area is defensible.
